claim_boundary: Portable interface templates only. No named organisation, participation, authorisation, data access, funding, or schedule is confirmed.

contracts.input: consented daily-life and accessibility questions; no continuous personal trace
contracts.permission: partner confirmation, participant notice/consent, purpose and retention record
contracts.output: de-identified barrier list and co-test task card
contracts.failure_handling: pause intake; delete or correct disputed record; return to human liaison
contracts.openness_level: L1 de-identified public method; raw notes restricted

contracts.interface: 未来科学城 / Future Science City
contracts.input: public or authorised research question and evaluation method
contracts.permission: institutional confirmation, source/licence and conflict record
contracts.output: versioned evaluation protocol with transfer limits
contracts.failure_handling: withdraw method; archive invalid result; disclose conflict or non-transferability
contracts.openness_level: L1 public protocol where rights permit

contracts.interface: 怀柔科学城 / Huairou Science City
contracts.input: authorised scientific question, synthetic/public test material, facility boundary
contracts.permission: institutional and facility confirmation; data/tool licence
contracts.output: reproducible test card and method limitation
contracts.failure_handling: isolate test; stop transfer; issue correction/withdrawal receipt
contracts.openness_level: L1 method open, sensitive inputs excluded

contracts.input: G2-cleared prototype, equipment list, stop/rollback record
contracts.permission: site, safety, data, equipment and operator authorisation
contracts.output: engineering test receipt, failure log and transfer boundary
contracts.failure_handling: physical stop, isolate equipment, close incident, reinstate site
contracts.openness_level: L0 public summary; technical detail by permission

contracts.input: scenario card, provenance card, gate/stop/exit templates
contracts.permission: receiving owner confirmation and local legal/site review
contracts.output: localised fork with version, differences and non-transferable conditions
contracts.failure_handling: do not scale; roll back local fork; publish correction and closure record
contracts.openness_level: L2 template open; local data and approvals excluded
